notes: Frozen authored synthetic narrative qualification corpus. Development chooses algorithm and no cutoff; held-out queries are scored without tuning. This is not a user-manuscript evaluation.
primary_metric: heldout mean nDCG@10; hybrid > safe legacy; exact queries must retain Recall@5=1

documents.text: Nafila stopped at the pharmacy before dawn. She bought medicine for her feverish brother, paid with three copper coins, and tucked the packet inside her blue coat. The pharmacist warned her to keep the tablets dry during the crossing.

Mara concealed the amber key beneath the lighthouse stairs. She wrapped it in sailcloth so that salt would not corrode its teeth. Only the keeper had seen her return from the eastern shore that night.
The river burst its banks after six days of rain. Villagers fled to the old monastery on the hill, carrying blankets and grain. The wooden bridge collapsed shortly after the last family crossed.
Idris burned the sealed letter before the captain could read it. He scattered the ashes into the harbor, concealing proof of the royal betrayal. He kept only the broken red wax seal as a reminder.
Sera promised to return the silver compass to her sister after the expedition. When the ship vanished, the promise remained unfulfilled. Every winter her sister waited on the quay for news.
Tomas could no longer wield his sword after the duel. A deep wound had severed the tendons in his right wrist. He learned to write with his left hand while recovering in the watchtower.

Queen Elara and General Voss formed a secret alliance against the northern invaders. Although their courts appeared hostile, their messengers exchanged battle plans every week. Their agreement depended on keeping the mountain pass open.

The town's drinking water became poisonous when waste from the abandoned mine seeped into the well. Lio traced the sickness to a cracked drainage tunnel. The council closed the well and brought clean water from the hills.

Cincin milik Ratri jatuh ke dalam sumur saat ia menarik ember. Damar turun menggunakan tali dan menemukan perhiasan itu di antara batu berlumpur. Ratri memberinya roti hangat sebagai ucapan terima kasih.
Peta jalur rahasia disembunyikan Bima di balik lukisan ruang makan. Jalur itu melewati terowongan di bawah tembok kota. Ia melarang adiknya memberitahu penjaga tentang pintu masuknya.

Kebakaran gudang pelabuhan dimulai dari lampu minyak yang terjatuh. Angin kencang membuat api menyebar ke atap rumah. Warga menyelamatkan anak-anak sebelum petugas berhasil memadamkan kobaran terakhir.
Utang keluarga Jaya dilunasi setelah ia menjual kebun warisan ibunya. Ia menyerahkan seluruh uang kepada saudagar yang menagihnya. Keluarganya akhirnya dapat meninggalkan kota tanpa dikejar penagih.
Alya mengetahui identitas penyamaran sang pangeran setelah melihat bekas luka di bahunya. Ia memilih merahasiakannya dari para penjaga. Sang pangeran mengira penyamarannya masih sempurna.
Nira meninggalkan desa untuk belajar ilmu pengobatan di ibu kota. Ayahnya mengantar sampai perbatasan hutan dan memberinya selimut tua. Mereka berpisah ketika matahari mulai terbit.
Badai memaksa kapal Arunika berlindung di teluk selama tiga malam. Sang nakhoda membatalkan rencana berlayar menuju pulau utara. Persediaan makanan mulai menipis sebelum laut kembali tenang.

Surat perintah penangkapan itu ternyata palsu. Wulan mengenali cap pejabat yang terbalik dan tinta yang belum kering. Ia menyembunyikan surat tersebut agar para pengawal tidak menangkap orang yang tidak bersalah.
The orchard bloomed early that spring. Amira counted the white flowers and planned the harvest with her neighbors. They repaired the fence to protect the young trees from roaming goats.
At the market, merchants argued over the price of wool. Rafi traded two baskets of apples for a pair of sturdy boots. A traveling musician played beside the fountain until sunset.
The archive was silent except for the rain against the windows. Hana sorted tax records and copied the names of retired officers. She locked the ledgers in their cabinet before leaving for supper.
Festival panen berlangsung di alun-alun. Anak-anak menari di bawah lentera sementara para petani membagikan nasi dan buah. Kepala desa membuka perayaan dengan memukul gendang tua.
The stable master fed the horses before sunrise. One restless mare had lost a shoe on the cobbled road. The apprentice fetched tools and waited patiently for the farrier to arrive.
Kebun istana dipenuhi bunga biru pada awal musim hujan. Tukang kebun memangkas ranting yang mati dan menanam bibit baru di dekat kolam. Para pelayan beristirahat di bawah pohon mangga.
The village teacher opened a new school beside the mill. Children practiced their letters on wooden slates. Their first lesson was a song about the changing seasons and the birds returning home.
Seorang pembuat tembikar membentuk kendi dari tanah liat merah. Ia mengeringkan hasil kerjanya di halaman lalu membakarnya di tungku. Kendi terbesar dipesan oleh pemilik kedai di ujung jalan.

queries.query: Where did people shelter when the river overflowed?
Where was the hidden route drawing placed?
Siapa menghancurkan pesan untuk menyembunyikan pengkhianatan?
What object was a sibling still waiting to get back?
Mengapa pendekar itu tidak bisa menggunakan tangan kanannya?
What started the blaze at the waterfront storehouse?
How did the family pay off what they owed?
Who recognized the disguised royal by a scar?
Why did the daughter travel to the capital?
How was the counterfeit arrest order discovered?
